query: As-cast HfMoTaTiZr has high strength at room temperature and elevated temperature but a relatively high density of 10.21 g cm−3. What single intervention could reduce its density without sacrificing its mechanical properties at room temperature and at elevated temperatures, including approximately 1000 °C? State the proposed intervention and mechanism, predict directional changes relative to as-cast HfMoTaTiZr, define the applicable temperature and loading boundaries, identify supporting prior evidence, and propose an experiment and rejection criterion that would falsify the hypothesis.

generation.hypothesis: The substitution of 10 at% of the heavy elements (Hf, Ta) with lighter elements (Sc, Y) in the HfMoTaTiZr high-entropy alloy will reduce its density by approximately 5-10% while maintaining its mechanical properties at room temperature and elevated temperatures, including 1000°C.
generation.intervention: Replacement of 10 at% of the heavy elements (Hf, Ta) with lighter elements (Sc, Y) via arc melting and casting
generation.conditions: Casting into a copper mold and subsequent heat treatment at 1000°C for 2 hours
generation.structural_mediator: Formation of a solid solution with reduced average atomic mass
generation.mechanism: The substitution of lighter elements for heavier ones will reduce the overall density of the alloy, while the preservation of the high-entropy effect will maintain its strength and stability at elevated temperatures
generation.predicted_outcome: A reduction in density of approximately 5-10% while maintaining the mechanical properties at room temperature and elevated temperatures, including 1000°C
generation.baseline: As-cast HfMoTaTiZr high-entropy alloy with a density of 10.21 g cm−3
generation.boundary: Temperature range: room temperature to 1000°C, loading conditions: tensile and compressive loading
generation.uncertainty: The actual reduction in density and the maintenance of mechanical properties may vary depending on the specific processing conditions and the resulting microstructure

falsification_experiment.design: Compare the density and mechanical properties of the alloy with and without the substitution of lighter elements
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the density is not reduced by at least 5% or the mechanical properties are compromised at elevated temperatures, the hypothesis is falsified
